evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies orphan handling and package transaction download in src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an orphan handling edge case where orphans admitted to the mempool via RPC trigger an Assume(false) assertion in net_processing. As described, 'An orphan that enters the mempool other than through peer relay (e.g. by RPC) stays in the orphanage, so Find1P1CPackage can pick it as the child of a reconsiderable parent, and package evaluation then reports it as MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hits Assume(false).'
